sponsored.t: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York
sponsored.sum: Extends certain tuition waivers for police officer students of the city university of New York to 2028.

sponsored.t: Extends the tax credits under the economic transformation and facility redevelopment program
sponsored.sum: Extends the tax credits under the economic transformation and facility redevelopment program until 2031.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage blueback herring
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage blueback herring.

sponsored.t: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage winter flounder
sponsored.sum: Extends the authority of the department of environmental conservation to manage winter flounder to 12/31/2029.

sponsored.t: Establishes a property tax exemption for police officers who serve in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a property tax exemption for police officers who serve in the state of New York; establishes the rate of such tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have been convicted of illegal dumping
sponsored.sum: Creates a publicly available list of persons who have been convicted of illegal dumping for a period of three years.

sponsored.t: Relates to property tax exemptions for nonprofit organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to property tax exemptions for nonprofit organizations; allows for nonprofit organizations to file an application for an exemption with the assessor no later than the taxable status date applicable to the following year's assessment roll where such nonprofit organization has purchased property after the taxable status date but prior to the levy of taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to setback requirements relating to the siting of battery energy storage systems
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of public service to promulgate rules, regulations and model policies regarding setback requirements for the siting of battery energy storage systems; requires minimum setback requirements for commercial energy storage systems, with a capacity of three megawatts or greater, of no less than seven hundred fifty feet from residential property and no less than three hundred feet from residential property located in a city with a population of one million or more inhabitants; requires public hearings prior to the approval of an application for a permit for such systems.

sponsored.t: Proposes a constitutional amendment relating to the formation of new towns
sponsored.sum: Proposes changes to article 9 of the constitution in relation to the formation of new towns by drawing a map and preparing a charter of the proposed town and preparing a petition relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to the application period for a real property tax exemption for surviving spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Provides that an application for a real property tax exemption for surviving spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty be filed with the assessor on or before the taxable status date.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reinstatement of certain officers and employees of the city of New York who were dismissed from employment due to a COVID-19 vaccine requirement
sponsored.sum: Requires the reinstatement of certain officers and employees of the city of New York who were dismissed from employment due to a COVID-19 vaccine requirement including retirees, vested members and members terminated without a one-year limit on return.

sponsored.t: Relates to transferring credits from a CUNY community college to a New York state university
sponsored.sum: Allows CUNY community college students to transfer all earned credits to a New York state university.

sponsored.t: Relates to toll reimbursement for all represented and non-represented persons employed by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Provides for toll reimbursement for port authority of New York and New Jersey employees for entering or exiting the port authority port district, the twenty-five mile radius of the Statue of Liberty National Monument.

sponsored.t: Relates to school bus parking on New York City streets
sponsored.sum: Prohibits school bus parking on city streets on weekdays between the hours of 5 p.m. and 5 a.m. and on weekends from 5 p.m. on Friday to 5 a.m. on Monday.

sponsored.t: Requires parental consent for sexual health education for certain students
sponsored.sum: Requires that public school districts provide parents with notice of curriculum and obtain parental consent prior to providing sexual health education to students ten years of age or younger.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxation of state correctional facility properties for schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to taxation of state correctional facility properties for schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing special review procedures for approval of development projects in marshlands by the city planning commission
sponsored.sum: Requires specific review procedures for approval of development projects in marshlands by the city planning commission including site plans, surveys, environmental review and community hearings and input.

sponsored.t: Requires every assessing unit to conduct a revaluation of assessment at least every eight years
sponsored.sum: Requires every assessing unit to conduct a revaluation of assessment at least every eight years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taxation of property owned by a cooperative corporation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of securing orders for certain crimes committed by individuals without permanent residency status
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of securing orders for offenses committed on a peace officer, police officer, firefighter, emergency medical services professional or uniformed worker by individuals without permanent residency status; provides such individuals shall be remanded to the custody of the sheriff for the entirety of the judicial proceedings related thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to abandoned vehicles
sponsored.sum: Increases the dollar value of abandoned vehicles which may be seized by a local authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of a medical immunization exemption form
sponsored.sum: Directs that a school in which a student is attending or will attend shall accept a medical immunization exemption.

sponsored.t: Requires the installation of trash capture nets on certain point source outlets
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner to promulgate rules and regulations requiring the department to install or cause to be installed at the outlet of any point source that empties into the waters of the state a trash capture net for purposes of collecting garbage, refuse, and other debris; defines "trash capture net" to mean a commercial grade, reusable, open-meshed material designed to capture pollutants as small as five millimeters in diameter.

sponsored.t: Requires the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority reimburse certain individuals from transit deserts
sponsored.sum: Requires the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority to reimburse certain individuals from transit deserts when they travel into the central business district who need medical treatment or are providing religious services; provides that such reimbursement shall be one hundred percent of all associated fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to taxation of state owned land
sponsored.sum: Provides for the taxation of state owned land for all purposes, exclusive of improvements and in accordance with any payment in lieu of taxes agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the tax exemption of capital improvements to residential buildings
sponsored.sum: Increases the cap on the real property tax exemption of capital improvements to residential buildings.

sponsored.t: Allows localities to grant an exemption from real property taxation for child day cares
sponsored.sum: Allows localities to grant an exemption from real property taxation for child day cares of up to 50% of the assessed value of such property.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting farm laborer internships earning college credit from the definition of employee and employment
sponsored.sum: Exempts service as a farm laborer where such service is an internship granting college course credit from the definition of employee and employment for the purposes of certain workers' compensation benefits.

sponsored.t: Requires warning labels on all containers that contain bisphenol A
sponsored.sum: Requires warning labels on all containers that contain bisphenol A that states it is harmful to an individual's health to microwave or otherwise heat such container.

sponsored.t: Provides discounted central business district tolls to individuals residing in transit deserts
sponsored.sum: Provides a fifty percent discount on all central business district tolls, fees and other charges to individuals residing in transit deserts; requires proof of residency.

sponsored.t: Establishes an energy-related public utility mass real property central assessment program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an energy-related public utility mass real property central assessment program.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax deduction for certain homeowners for the cost of sidewalk repairs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax deduction for homeowners in a city with a population of one million or more for the cost of sidewalk repairs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of surplus proceeds from a tax foreclosure sale
sponsored.sum: Provides for the distribution of proceeds from a tax foreclosure sale; requires notice to a former property owner of the existence of a surplus.

sponsored.t: Provides test preparation for certain students intending to apply to take the specialized high school admissions test
sponsored.sum: Provides test preparation for students in the seventh grade and eighth grade intending to apply to take the specialized high school admissions test.

sponsored.t: Establishes the incontinence supplies insurance program for Medicaid beneficiaries
sponsored.sum: Establishes the incontinence supplies insurance program for Medicaid beneficiaries who are also residents of the state of New York and obtain a note from a physician indicating a need for an item.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority install fire extinguishers in every subway station and each subway car and bus
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority install fire extinguishers in every subway station and each subway car and bus.

sponsored.t: Provides for state aid for certain cities, towns, villages or fire districts adversely affected by a concentration of tax exempt property
sponsored.sum: Provides for state aid for certain cities, towns, villages or fire districts adversely affected by a concentration of tax exempt property.

sponsored.t: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation
sponsored.sum: Subjects certain state lands to real property taxation within Orange county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enforcement of taxes in certain school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the enforcement of taxes in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Provides a non-revenue E-ZPass to every sworn officer of the metropolitan transportation police department
sponsored.sum: Provides a non-revenue E-ZPass to every sworn officer of the metropolitan transportation police department; provides for the disposal of such E-ZPass after a police officer leaves the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Creates distinctive license plates for funeral service vehicles
sponsored.sum: Creates distinctive license plates for funeral homes and directors for service vehicles used for the purpose of transporting human remains.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "safe haven baby box act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "safe haven baby box act" to provide a defense to endangering the welfare of a child; defines "safe haven baby box" to mean a secure, climate-controlled device installed at a facility staffed twenty-four hours per day, seven days per week, including but not limited to hospitals, police stations, fire stations, and emergency medical service facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for surviving spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residences of surviving spouses of police officers killed in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Directs the New York state energy research and development authority to establish a pilot program to install a microgrid in Glenwood Houses
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York state energy and research development authority to establish a pilot program to install a microgrid in Glenwood Houses; requires the authority to annually report on the results of such program and any recommendations for expansion.
